mapper.sql: id, order_no, tenant_id, user_id, agent_id, invite_code, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, receiver_province, receiver_city, receiver_district, receiver_detail_address, total_amount, freight_amount, discount_amount, pay_amount, total_pv, total_cost, status, pay_type, remark, pay_time, delivery_company, delivery_no, delivery_time, receive_time, cancel_time, close_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dms_shop_order WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM dms_shop_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM dms_shop_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT FROM dms_shop_order WHERE user_id = #{userId}
AND status = 0
AND status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.status IN (0, 4, 5, 6) )
AND status = 2
AND status = 3 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_order_item oi LEFT JOIN dms_shop_product_review review ON review.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE oi.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND review.id IS NULL )
AND ( status = 5 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id ) )
ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_payment, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = o.id AND sale.status IN (0, 4, 5, 6) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_shipment, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_receipt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 3 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_order_item oi LEFT JOIN dms_shop_product_review review ON review.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE oi.order_id = o.id AND review.id IS NULL ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_review, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = o.id AND sale.status IN (0, 4, 5, 6) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS after_sale FROM dms_shop_order o WHERE o.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, 0 AS pending_payment, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = o.id AND sale.status IN (0, 4, 5, 6) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_shipment, 0 AS pending_receipt, 0 AS pending_review, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = o.id AND sale.status IN (0, 4, 5, 6) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS after_sale FROM dms_shop_order o WHERE COALESCE(o.tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId}
SELECT FROM dms_shop_order WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM dms_shop_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT FROM dms_shop_order
AND status = #{status}
AND status = 0
AND status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.status IN (0, 4, 5, 6) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.status IN (0, 4, 5, 6) )
AND status = 3 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.status IN (0, 4, 5, 6) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.status = 1 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.status IN (0, 4, 5, 6) )
AND ( order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR receiver_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR receiver_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_shop_order (id, order_no, tenant_id, user_id, agent_id, invite_code, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, receiver_province, receiver_city, receiver_district, receiver_detail_address, total_amount, freight_amount, discount_amount, pay_amount, total_pv, total_cost, status, pay_type, remark, pay_time, delivery_company, delivery_no, delivery_time, receive_time, cancel_time, close_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderNo}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{agentId}, #{inviteCode}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{receiverProvince}, #{receiverCity}, #{receiverDistrict}, #{receiverDetailAddress}, #{totalAmount}, #{freightAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{totalPv}, #{totalCost}, #{status}, #{payType}, #{remark}, #{payTime}, #{deliveryCompany}, #{deliveryNo}, #{deliveryTime}, #{receiveTime}, #{cancelTime}, #{closeTime})
mapper.update:
UPDATE dms_shop_order SET status = 1,
pay_type = #{payType},
pay_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE dms_shop_order SET agent_id=#{agentId}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE dms_shop_order SET status = 2, delivery_company = #{deliveryCompany}, delivery_no = #{deliveryNo}, delivery_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE dms_shop_order SET status = 3, receive_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2
UPDATE dms_shop_order SET status = 4, cancel_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE dms_shop_order SET status = 4, close_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dms_shop_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3)
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_shop_order SET status = 4, close_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
